mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APV_SUBMISSION (template_id, template_nm, schema_snapshot, field_values, title, requester_id, requester_nm, atch_file_id) VALUES (#{templateId}, #{templateNm}, #{schemaSnapshot}, #{fieldValues}, #{title}, #{requesterId}, #{requesterNm}, #{atchFileId})
mapper.select: SELECT submission_id, template_id, template_nm, title, requester_id, requester_nm, atch_file_id, status, current_step_order, submitted_at, completed_at FROM APV_SUBMISSION WHERE requester_id = #{value} ORDER BY submission_id DESC

SELECT submission_id, template_id, template_nm, schema_snapshot, field_values, title, requester_id, requester_nm, atch_file_id, status, current_step_order, submitted_at, completed_at FROM APV_SUBMISSION WHERE submission_id = #{value}

SELECT ESNTL_ID AS uniq_id, USER_NM AS emplyr_nm, ORGNZT_ID AS orgnzt_id FROM COMTNEMPLYRINFO WHERE EMPLYR_STTUS_CODE = 'P'
